description: An offline magnetic compass for Android, with spoken headings, optional GPS altitude estimates and practical light tools.
features: Read magnetic headings with a clear degree dial and accuracy feedback
Hear headings using an installed offline voice
Enable GPS altitude estimates with reference and uncertainty labels
Use the LED lantern, adjustable red screen light, SOS and Quick Settings torch tile
proDescription: Optional Northlight Pro adds up to eight saved magnetic bearings, spoken phone-turn guidance, optional alignment vibration, amber and green screen lights, and an adjustable strobe through a one-time Google Play purchase. Core compass, speech, GPS altitude, lantern, red light and SOS remain free. Your local Pro price is shown before purchase.
limitation: Compass accuracy depends on the phone's sensors and nearby magnetic interference. GPS altitude is approximate; read the displayed reference and vertical uncertainty. Bearing cues describe phone orientation, not routes or safe paths. SOS is a flashing light, not an emergency call. Flash brightness and haptics depend on hardware and Android settings.
tutorialHeading: Read a compass heading on your Android phone
tutorialDescription: Follow the magnetic compass, calibration, spoken-heading, GPS altitude and light-tool steps with real Northlight screenshots.
